recipe.title: Garlic tomato pasta
steps:
Boil the pasta
Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling water according to the packet instructions until al dente.

Make the sauce
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and stir in the minced garlic for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10–12 minutes until slightly thickened.

Combine and serve
Drain the pasta and toss it with the sauce. Divide between two bowls.

reason: 200 g dry pasta with a tomato sauce is a coherent meal for two without requiring a protein category.
